exit_codes.0: PASS — commit receipt, auto-advance to next gate
exit_codes.3: INFRA_FAIL — retry once with identical inputs; if second failure, stop
exit_codes.4: VALID_SCIENTIFIC_NEGATIVE — stop, preserve all outputs, await review
exit_codes.5: HOLD_REVIEW — stop immediately, no parameter tuning allowed

gate_requirements.upstream_sha_check: every gate verifies upstream receipt SHA before starting
gate_requirements.hold_packet_format: failed gate, failed predicates, last passing receipt SHA, source commit, exact commands, logs, artifact paths, observed metrics, suspected causes (marked hypotheses)
